# Design point P011

## Description

The Rails monolith would access repositories through local-disk copies treated as reconstructible warm caches rather than fixed authoritative replicas. If a cache failed, repository state would need to be reconstructed, although these choices do not specify the authoritative source or the client-side scaling mechanisms used.
